resources.harvesting_rule: carried_harvest_energy = min(payload_target, carried_harvest_energy + relative_harvest_rate * dt) while near-field and strict LOS are valid; otherwise accumulation pauses and retained energy remains carried.
resources.controller_information_boundary: Solar Left/Center/Right, near-field harvest-valid state, current local obstacle sensing. No resource x/y, distance, bearing, rate, quality, or source ranking.

mission: research; success requires net Nest Energy >= target
